##  A dockable window that display entire scene added in Editor Build Setting
![img001a](editor-window-access.gif)

# 2. Load Scene with ease
![img001a](editor-window-load.gif)

# 3. Filter Scenes easily
 ## - `Add/Remove` Scene from Favorite scene Collection for easy filtering of Scene

![img001a](editor-window-filter.gif)
## - `Search Bar` for easy filter using `keyword`.
![img001a](editor-window-search.gif)

# Buttons Functionality
1. `(Button) Load` - Close all current open Scenes and loads a Scene.

2. `(Button) Addt` - Adds a Scene to the current open Scenes and loads it.

3. `(Button) ★` - Add Scene to Favorite Collection.

4. `(Button) ꭙ` - Remove Scene from Favorite Collection
